info.title: UK Trade Tariff API V3
info.description: GOV.UK Online Trade Tariff API V3. Flat JSON responses designed for third-party developers and LLM/AI agents. No JSONAPI envelope. Anonymous access - no authentication required. Version negotiated via Accept header (application/vnd.hmrc.3.0+json) or URL path prefix (/uk/api/v3/).

total.description: Total number of items in the collection

get.description: Returns import and export measures applicable to this commodity on the current date. Use ?as_of=YYYY-MM-DD for a historic date.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Date to evaluate measures against (ISO 8601). Defaults to today.

get.description: Returns available exchange rate periods. UK service only. Use the year and type parameters to filter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Geographical area ID (ISO country code or group ID)

get.description: Returns quota order numbers. Useful for looking up quota identifiers before fetching quota details.
Extensible reports namespace. Returns the list of available reports. Currently empty - reports will be added incrementally.
Full-text search across commodity codes, chapter and heading descriptions. Returns ranked results. Powered by OpenSearch.
Returns all tariff sections. Sections group chapters into broad categories of goods.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Ten-digit goods nomenclature item ID for a non-declarable subheading
